Success envelope: handleAPI answers {ok:true,data}; status 201 for POST/PATCH/PUT, 200 for GET/DELETE (defaultStatusCode). Error envelope: {ok:false,error,code[,data]} where code derives from the status (bad_request, unauthorized, forbidden, not_found, payload_too_large, service_unavailable, internal_server_error) and data carries the RequestError extra (e.g. {body:<normalized request body>}).

A signed auth chain takes precedence: with req.auth set the Authorization header is ignored entirely.
Authorization missing or not starting with 'Bearer ' -> treated as anonymous (next()).
'Bearer ...' with EVENTS_ADMIN_AUTH_TOKEN unset -> 503 'EVENTS_ADMIN_AUTH_TOKEN is not configured; events admin endpoints are disabled'.
auth() without an auth chain on a non-optional route -> 401 'Unauthorized'; a bad chain -> the @dcl/crypto-middleware error (400/401, message not reproduced here).
withAuthProfile() (POST /api/events, POST attendees, posters) -> 404 'Not found profile for "<user>"' when the Catalyst profile lookup finds nothing.
